This article is about requests for travelers in Potion Maker. For the quests, see Quests.

Requests are tasks that the player can ask travelers to perform. They can be accessed during a quest, or on the request menu screen. If requests are started during a quest, the quest is cancelled and the traveler will do that instead. If requests are started on the request menu screen, it will cost the player 3 rubies.

Requests will cost coins in order to be performed, however, if the request was started through the request menu with rubies, it will be not cost any coins.
